properties.headline: Frost Advisory issued September 25 at 3:02AM EDT until September 25 at 9:00AM EDT by NWS Baltimore MD/Washington DC
properties.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures as low as 33 will result in frost formation.

* WHERE...In Maryland, Garrett County. In Virginia, Western Highland
County. In West Virginia, Western Grant and Western Pendleton
Counties.

* WHEN...Until 9 AM EDT this morning.

* IMPACTS...Frost could harm sensitive outdoor vegetation. Sensitive
outdoor plants may be killed if left uncovered.
properties.instruction: Protect tender plants from the cold.

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued September 21 at 7:03AM EDT by NWS Baltimore MD/Washington DC
properties.description:
Localized dense fog has developed along the higher terrain this
morning. This affects Interstate 68 at Big Savage Mountain and
Keyser's Ridge. Motorists should use extra caution when driving
this morning. Reduce speed, leave extra travel time and following
distance, and use low beam headlights.
